correctness.rationale: Every nonzero Klein-four character gives a genus-two Artin--Schreier quotient; the conductor genus formula gives genus six. Character eigenspace factorization identifies the zeta numerator as the product of their quartic numerators. Exact enumeration over F4 and F16 gives each of the three distinct genus-two polynomials using the Weil functional equation. Cyclotomic orders 4,12,5 and Tate isogeny theorem prove not just existence but the iff divisibility conditions with least degrees 3,20,60. Reexecuted embedded script checks all 4 coefficients, 12 genus-two factors, Jacobian orders and all powers 1 to120. Finite checks are exhaustive for F4 and F16, while the infinite assertion is a proof by root orders.

Comparing mathematical statements finds no prior derivation of the coupled genus-six four-case classification with sharp cross-parameter least extension degrees 3,20,60.
